name: Zoho Projects
description: Zoho Projects is project-management software for planning work, coordinating tasks and milestones, tracking time, collaborating, and reporting on delivery.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact Zoho Projects portal through Relay-owned Multi-DC offline OAuth. Agents may list at most twenty-five privacy-redacted projects, list at most twenty-five privacy-redacted tasks in one exact project, or read one exact task. Relay pins the portal, Accounts and API data centers, three read scopes, current V3 product-prefixed endpoints, first page, limits, IDs, returned fields, refresh, revocation, and approval boundary while excluding people, descriptions, comments, attachments, custom fields, time and billing data, broader work data, searches, writes, pagination, bulk APIs, and exports.

blocked.description: Other portals, milestones, task lists, timesheets, forums, events, documents, users, teams, analytics, settings, and administration are outside V1.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary searches or API calls
blocked.description: Other products, portals, regions, scopes, endpoints, methods, fields, includes, filters, searches, query parameters, versions, and raw requests are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export project data
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, deep pages, synchronization, feeds, webhooks, bulk APIs, downloads, imports, and exports are outside V1.
